map.单位电耗多少合理？: What specific electricity use is reasonable?
map.常规活性污泥约 0.2–0.4 kWh/m³，提标（脱氮除磷）与再生水会升高。结: Conventional activated sludge uses about 0.2–0.4 kWh/m³, and upgraded treatment (nitrogen and phosphorus removal) and water reuse push it higher. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.高效曝气、智能加药与水泵变频是主要节能点，可显著降单位电耗。结果按公开标准与环境: High-efficiency aeration, intelligent chemical dosing and variable-frequency pumps are the main saving points and can clearly lower specific electricity use. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.

Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.单位能耗 = 日均电耗 ×24 ÷ 日均处理量（kWh/m³）；吨水电费 = 单: Energy intensity = daily electricity ×24 ÷ daily throughput (kWh/m³); cost per ton of water = energy intensity ×0.6 (CNY/m³); estimated share of lifting energy = 0.004 × head (m) ×100%. Validation: electricity, throughput, and head must be valid positive numbers; throughput (the denominator) ≠0.
